ios.desc:
The most private browser for iPhone. Every tab is completely isolated: separate cookies, storage, and its own IP address from 40+ global proxy servers. Built by Mysk, featured on TechRadar.

BROWSE THE WEB IN SILOS  
- True Tab Isolation: Every tab is its own “silo” with separate storage, cookies, and even IP address.
- Per-Silo Proxy: Assign any of our 40+ global proxy locations to each silo - place one in Canada, another in Germany, a third in Brazil, and more.

FAST, NO-LOG, PRIVATE PROXIES  
- Global Proxy Network: Access 40+ high-performance proxy servers worldwide, and no logs are ever kept.  
- Built-in Security: Automatic HTTPS upgrades, DNS-level tracker blocking, and more — no configuration required.

ALWAYS-ON, SELF-CONTAINED, PRIVACY 
- Silos never share data and are always connected to our proxies, so you’re protected without having to remember a VPN switch.
- Psylo does not interfere or change your system's settings or other installed VPNs — all protections live inside the app

ANTI-TRACKING BEYOND A VPN  
- Deep Integration: Psylo’s proxy network and browser work together to block fingerprinting that VPNs can’t offer.  
- Smart Location Spoofing: Psylo matches your system's locale and timezone to your proxy’s location, preventing a common tracking method that would reveal your location even with a VPN turned on.
- Content Filtering: Block ads, cookie banners, app-install popups, and other web annoyances.
- URL Tracking Cleaner: Automatically strips tracking parameters from URLs as you browse.

PRIVATE WEB APPS  
- Ditch native apps: Use web versions (PWAs) of X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and enjoy Psylo’s full privacy protections.  
- Multiple accounts: Run side-by-side instances without cross-tracking.

EPHEMERAL AND PERSISTENT MODES  
- Persistent Silos: For long-term browsing and web apps.
- Ephemeral Silos: Auto-purge on close for one-off sessions.

NO-FRILLS, PRIVACY FIRST
- Zero Web3 tokens, no AI agents — just privacy.
- Detailed SSL/TLS certificate viewer
- Search Engines: Set a default search engine or add your own custom engines.
